name: Luk Chup
description: Miniature mung bean paste sweets hand-painted to resemble perfect tiny fruits and vegetables.
ingredients: a handful of fresh mint, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with coconut oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the roti dough and ground turmeric until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the lime wedges with the coconut milk until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 20 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
Bring your lime wedges to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
